component.name: SearchScreen
component.script:
sub init() m.kb = m.top.findNode("kb") m.grid = m.top.findNode("grid") m.count = m.top.findNode("count") m.all = [] m.res = 0 m.inGrid = false m.kb.observeField("text", "onText") m.kb.observeField("submit", "onSubmit") m.grid.observeField("itemSelected", "onPick") end sub
sub refocus() if m.inGrid and m.res > 0 m.grid.setFocus(true) else m.inGrid = false m.kb.setFocus(true) end if end sub
sub onItems() m.all = m.top.items for each it in m.all it.nt = Norm(it.title) end for filterItems("") end sub
sub onText() filterItems(m.kb.text) end sub
sub onSubmit() if m.res > 0 m.inGrid = true m.grid.setFocus(true) end if end sub
sub filterItems(q as String) nq = Norm(q) out = [] for each it in m.all if nq = "" or Instr(1, it.nt, nq) > 0 out.Push(it) if out.Count() >= 300 then exit for end if end for m.res = out.Count() m.grid.content = BuildNode(out) m.count.text = m.res.ToStr() + " resultados" end sub
sub onPick() c = m.grid.content if c = invalid then return n = c.getChild(m.grid.itemSelected) if n <> invalid then m.top.picked = ItemInfo(n) end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if m.grid.isInFocusChain() if key = "left" or key = "back" m.inGrid = false m.kb.setFocus(true) return true end if else if key = "right" and m.res > 0 m.inGrid = true m.grid.setFocus(true) return true end if end if return false end function
